package com.gsmbypasspro.vpn;

import android.content.Intent;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.View;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;
import android.os.Build;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;
import androidx.drawerlayout.widget.DrawerLayout;
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.Locale;

public class MainActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private boolean isConnected = false;
    private DrawerLayout drawerLayout;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_main);

        drawerLayout = findViewById(R.id.drawerLayout);
        final Button btnConnect = findViewById(R.id.btnConnect);
        final TextView tvLogs = findViewById(R.id.tvLogs);

        // Menus du tiroir latéral
        findViewById(R.id.menuConfig).setOnClickListener(new View.OnClickListener() {
            @Override
            public void onClick(View v) {
                Toast.makeText(MainActivity.this, "Gestion des configurations (Import/Export)", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                drawerLayout.closeDrawers();
            }
        });

        findViewById(R.id.menuTunnelType).setOnClickListener(new View.OnClickListener() {
            @Override
            public void onClick(View v) {
                Toast.makeText(MainActivity.this, "Protocoles : VLess, VMess, Trojan, SSH", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                drawerLayout.closeDrawers();
            }
        });

        findViewById(R.id.menuInject).setOnClickListener(new View.OnClickListener() {
            @Override
            public void onClick(View v) {
                Toast.makeText(MainActivity.this, "Paramètres d'injection et Payload actifs", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                drawerLayout.closeDrawers();
            }
        });

        // Redirection vers votre groupe WhatsApp
        findViewById(R.id.menuCommunity).setOnClickListener(new View.OnClickListener() {
            @Override
            public void onClick(View v) {
                String whatsappUrl = "https://chat.whatsapp.com/VOTRE_LIEN_DE_GROUPE";
                Intent intent = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW, Uri.parse(whatsappUrl));
                startActivity(intent);
                drawerLayout.closeDrawers();
            }
        });

        findViewById(R.id.menuSettings).setOnClickListener(new View.OnClickListener() {
            @Override
            public void onClick(View v) {
                Toast.makeText(MainActivity.this, "Ports UDPGW (7300), DNS (1.1.1.1) configurés", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                drawerLayout.closeDrawers();
            }
        });

        findViewById(R.id.menuAbout).setOnClickListener(new View.OnClickListener() {
            @Override
            public void onClick(View v) {
                Toast.makeText(MainActivity.this, "GSM BYPASS-PRO VPN v1.0 - Ultra Rapide", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                drawerLayout.closeDrawers();
            }
        });

        String timeNow = new SimpleDateFormat("HH:mm:ss", Locale.getDefault()).format(new Date());
        tvLogs.setText("[" + timeNow + "] Moteur VLess / Tunnel prêt sur " + Build.MODEL);

        btnConnect.setOnClickListener(new View.OnClickListener() {
            @Override
            public void onClick(View v) {
                String t = new SimpleDateFormat("HH:mm:ss", Locale.getDefault()).format(new Date());
                if (!isConnected) {
                    tvLogs.append("\n[" + t + "] Connexion au serveur distant chiffrée...");
                    tvLogs.append("\n[" + t + "] Tunnel actif - Vitesse ultra rapide 🚀");
                    btnConnect.setText("DISCONNECT");
                    isConnected = true;
                } else {
                    tvLogs.append("\n[" + t + "] Déconnexion du tunnel.");
                    btnConnect.setText("CONNECT");
                    isConnected = false;
                }
            }
        });
    }
}
